entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something and I'm not taking no for an answer. This is completely unacceptable!
I can certainly look into that for you. I understand you're upset. To get started, could you please provide your order number?
It's VF86753. I bought this jersey, and it's the wrong size. It's way too tight and I can't even wear it. I need to get this sorted out right now.
Okay, I have your order pulled up now. I see the VeloFit Performance Jersey. So to be clear, is it a technical fault with the jersey or a preference on the sizing?

It's the SIZE! Are you not listening? It's too tight! I want to exchange it. And don't you dare tell me I'm outside some window, I know what your policy says. If you can't handle this, put a manager on the phone immediately!
There's no need for that, I can absolutely help you. I'm just confirming the details here. I see your order was delivered 59 days ago.
So what? Your website says 90 days! I swear, if you try to deny this I'm going to light you up on every review site on the internet.

Not at all, sir. You are correct. Our standard items, like this jersey, have a 90-day return policy. Since you're at 59 days, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund or an exchange. We can definitely process that for you.
Oh. So you're just going to do it? No hassle?

That's correct. I apologize that the jersey was the wrong size. I can start the exchange for the next size up right now and email you a pre-paid return label for the one that's too tight. Would that work for you?
Yeah... yeah, that would be great. A size Large, please.
Of course. I have processed the exchange for a size Large. The return label is on its way to your email inbox now. Once we see the original item has been shipped, your new jersey will be sent out.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
